## Activity

During December 2023, Harbour Eye Clinic completed 386 captures. This activity represents the imaging recorded at the site during the month. The reported capture volume provides the basis for the subsequent image-quality and grading measures.

The service also reported no new equipment faults during December 2023. No operational issue was identified in the information provided for this reporting period.

## Image quality

Of the 386 captures, 11 were marked ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.8. This result indicates that most images were suitable for the grading process, while the ungradable images could not be assessed from the available capture.

## Grading

A total of 104 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 3 days. This is the midpoint measure for the time between capture and completion of grading during December 2023.

The activity, image-quality and grading figures should be read together when reviewing the site’s performance for the month. Harbour Eye Clinic recorded the stated capture volume, with the reported ungradable rate and referable results alongside a median grading lag of 3 days.
